text:CREATE TABLE kinds (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    "odd ""name""" TEXT,
    [bracket col] BLOB,
    `tick` REAL,
    n NUMERIC DEFAULT 0, added TEXT DEFAULT 'later', added_real REAL DEFAULT -2, -- a comment
    CHECK (id > 0)
)
text:CREATE TABLE alias_by_table_key (x INTEGER, y TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (x DESC))
text:CREATE TABLE no_alias_desc (x INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DESC, y TEXT)
text:CREATE TABLE no_alias_int (x INT PRIMARY KEY, y TEXT)

text:CREATE TABLE gen (
    a INTEGER, b TEXT, c AS (a * 2) VIRTUAL,
    d TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (upper(b)) STORED, e TEXT
)
text:CREATE TABLE wr (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
text:CREATE TABLE "quoted table" ("a b", 'c' TEXT /* inline */, d DEFAULT x'0a0b')
text:CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT id FROM kinds
text:CREATE TRIGGER trg AFTER INSERT ON gen BEGIN SELECT 1; END
